title: Recall: Bind values and choose concrete types
summary: Reconstruct complete expressions using the specified reference form. Formatting may vary; alternative implementations belong in Apply. Each clue states its own context because surrounding code is hidden in Recall.

shadow.clue: Given an existing spaces: &str, write a complete let statement shadowing spaces with its byte length. Keep the name spaces and include the semicolon.

array.clue: Write a complete let statement defining readings as the explicitly typed three-element u32 array containing 4, 5 and 6, in that order. Include the semicolon.
